description: This source file, ki2gm.py, is a Python script that converts KiCad drill files (.drl) into a format compatible with the gerbmerge program. It reads an input .drl file, performs specific line substitutions based on a mapping, and writes the result to an output .drl file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that handles argument parsing, file reading, line remapping, and writing the output file.
